results: On the entire original period-two H1 domain, the zero-potential eigen-equation is exactly diagonal. A nonzero eigenvector exists exactly at a genuine free value pi^2*n^2, n>=0. No additional free spectral values exist in the original physical endpoint realization.

Actual physical unit modes are constructed from the original smooth Fourier modes. Scalar amplitudes biject with the full constant eigenspace; two signed amplitudes biject with every full positive free eigenspace. Their complex dimensions are exactly one and two.

Native real semisimplicity transfers these geometric dimensions to the ACTUAL full physical algebraic multiplicities of the original zero source potential. The complete free multiplicity sequence is one at n=0 and two at every n>=1.
For N>=2, the already verified central edge pi^2*N^2-12N cuts the actual free spectrum exactly at n<N. The actual finite source central spectrum equals the image of range(N) under n->pi^2*n^2.

sourceCentralAlgebraicCount_zero proves that the existing sum of ACTUAL original physical algebraic multiplicities in the free central spectrum is exactly2N-1. This is the free baseline; its invariance under a change of original potential remains unproved.
qualifications: The count2N-1 is proved for the ACTUAL zero-potential central spectrum. It is not asserted for a nonzero potential without a proved invariance theorem.
The signed positive Fourier modes are independent only for n>=1; the constant mode is treated separately and has multiplicity one.
No canonical perturbed label, source parity identification, Birkhoff map, KdV frequency or actual KdV flow is claimed complete.
